meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按计划分步执行代码任务并设置审查节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有详细的实现计划需要分步执行并接受审查
copy.tagline_en: Execute implementation plans step by step with review checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed implementation plan to execute in stages with review

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会加载你的书面实施计划，逐条执行每个步骤并验证，遇到障碍立即询问，完成后自动切换到分支结项流程。
howto.when: 当你有书面实施计划需要在一个独立会话中执行，并告知 Claude 使用此技能时触发。

say.text: 请执行这个计划文件，逐条完成所有步骤。
say.note: Claude 会加载计划并开始执行。

say.text: 加载 plan.md，审查并开始实施。
say.note: Claude 会读取 plan.md 并进行审查。

say.text: 遇到障碍时停下来问我，不要猜测。
say.note: Claude 会在阻塞时停止并请求澄清。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude loads your written implementation plan, executes each step exactly with verification, stops and asks when blocked, and transitions to branch finishing upon completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a written plan to execute in a separate session and instruct Claude to use this skill.

say_en.text: Execute this plan file step by step.
Load plan.md, review and begin implementation.
Stop and ask me if blocked, don't guess.
say_en.note: Claude halts on blockers and requests clarification.
